newsitem.title: USA: LeCroy prices 1.6 mln-shr public offering.
newsitem.headline: LeCroy prices 1.6 mln-shr public offering.

text.p: LeCroy Corp said Wednesday it recently priced a public offering of 1,650,000 shares of its common stock at $26 per share.
Of the 1,650,000 shares being offered, the company said 1,330,808 shares are being offered by certain selling stockholders, with an additional 319,192 shares being offered by the company.
In addition, the company said it granted the underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to an additional 247,500 shares.
